lessons.title: Route one entity to one coordinator
lessons.question: How can a Worker use a Durable Object namespace, stable ID, and stub to send requests for the same entity to one stateful coordinator?
lessons.focus: Document-to-chunk provenance, Durable Object identity/stubs, and rank ordering.

lessons.title: Inspect retry and batching decisions
lessons.question: If a queue consumer fails while processing a message, how should retries and batching be considered?
lessons.focus: Retrieval candidates versus context selection for delivery behavior.

lessons.title: Choose KV or R2 from access semantics
lessons.question: What is the tradeoff between Workers KV eventual consistency for global configuration and R2 object storage for mutable files?
lessons.focus: Multi-document evidence and a constrained context pack.

lessons.title: Pause and resume durable work
lessons.question: How can a long-running multi-step process pause, retry, and resume safely?
lessons.focus: Prompt construction, saved grounded answer, and citations.
